notes.title: ATRI & Adabana Odd Tales Celebrate Their 5th Anniversary!
notes.content: [h3]ATRI and Adabana Odd Tales have reached their 5th anniversary since release.[/h3][p]We sincerely thank everyone who has played these games.[/p][p]We look forward to your continued support for both titles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36908040/10c4a2652c4fdb2992840cec19ae2396cfd88a2b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Also, the ANIPLEX.EXE Summer Sale is now underway.[/h3][p][/p][p][b]ATRI -My Dear Moments- 55% OFF[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1230140/ATRI_My_Dear_Moments/"][/dynamiclink][b]Adabana Odd Tales 55% OFF[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094820/_/"][/dynamiclink][b]Hira Hira Hihiru 35% OFF[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2314820/_/"][/dynamiclink][b]Seedsow Lullaby　20% OFF[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2748830/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Additionally, for a limited time during the sale period,[/b][/p][p][b]the ANIPLEX.EXE BUNDLE is available at 20% OFF![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34932/ANIPLEXEXE_BUNDLE/"][/dynamiclink]Period: June 19 – July 10 \[JST][/p][p][/p][p]Please take this opportunity to check it out![/p][p][/p]
